method.choices: Wizard survival priorities select only actual offered Tactics, Equipment and Skills. No health resets or injected kills in the natural campaign.
method.controls: Eight-direction physical-key input at 12 Hz, ordinary collision movement, AStarGrid2D obstacle routing, visible cue avoidance and emergency dash. Navigation bounds come from the actual arena.
method.damage_definition: Sum of actual HP removed by accepted damage_player calls, after armor/invulnerability and capped at remaining HP on lethal hits; healing does not subtract from this counter.
method.limitations: One automated seed/build, not a human win-rate estimate. Exact visible cue geometry favors the controller; navigation and cue avoidance are approximate. A 240-second stage limit includes wave downtime.
method.outcomes: Cleared, died, or still alive at the 240-second timeout. A timeout is not a death; clear-time medians exclude timeouts/deaths.
method.progression: Natural full run: real attacks, XP, drops and healing; no injected kills or health resets. Automatic center-portal entry only after combat and all rewards.
